title: capsicum frutescens var. baccatum
intro: Capsicum frutescens var. baccatum, commonly known as Aji Amarillo, is a variety of pepper plant that belongs to the Capsicum species. Aji Amarillo is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, as well as its antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Aji Amarillo are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including capsaicinoids, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, Aji Amarillo has been used in traditional medicine for its purported ability to treat various conditions, including fever, pain, and respiratory issues.
